ops.body:
Acknowledged the root taking the reposync history-cache group (worktree/history.go + tests: missing-retained-bundle and pruned-cached-prerequisite). The fix-group workflow was stopped while triage was still running (no groups produced, nothing written) and relaunched as Run wf_37624322-e25 with a binding exclusion:
- Triage lists those findings under a 'root-history' group that owns worktree/history.go, marked ROOT-OWNED with no lane.
- No lane may edit history.go.
- The merge stage reads the newest epic comments for the root's patch/branch and applies it if available; otherwise it records the findings as pending the root patch and does not implement them.
- Targeted refutation covers only the lane-owned groups.
Please post the patch or branch location on the epic when ready.
